Comedy Fantasy

Author: Akagane Musashi

Status: Ongoing

Yuiitsu Muni no Saikyou Tamer (唯一無二の最強テイマー, The One and Only Strongest Tamer) is a Japanese fantasy manga that follows the journey of a protagonist destined to become the most powerful tamer in a world filled with magical beasts and dangerous adventures. Despite being underestimated by peers and rivals, he possesses unique abilities and an unyielding determination to tame and command extraordinary creatures. Throughout his journey, he faces formidable challenges, battles powerful enemies, and uncovers hidden truths about the magical world, all while strengthening the bond with his summoned companions. Yuiitsu Muni no Saikyou Tamer stands out for its thrilling action, creative magical systems, and the protagonist’s strategic approach to taming and combat. With dynamic fight scenes, captivating world-building, and the themes of perseverance and growth, this manga offers fans an exciting blend of adventure, fantasy, and tactical storytelling that keeps readers engaged from start to finish.

Fuufu Ijou, Koibito Miman.

7.60

Comedy Drama Romance School Life Slice Of Life

Author: Kanamaru Yuki

Status: Ongoing

Fuufu Ijou, Koibito Miman. (夫婦以上、恋人未満。, More Than a Married Couple, But Not Lovers) is a Japanese romantic comedy manga by Yūki Kanamaru that captures the awkward yet heartfelt journey of high school students navigating love and relationships under unusual circumstances. The story follows Jirou Yakuin, a laid-back gamer, who is suddenly partnered with the lively and popular Akari Watanabe for a school program where students must live together as “married couples” to earn grades. Despite their clashing personalities and initial reluctance, the two begin to develop unexpected chemistry as they struggle to present themselves as a believable couple while harboring feelings for their actual crushes. Fuufu Ijou, Koibito Miman. combines comedy, slice-of-life moments, and genuine emotional tension, making it a refreshing take on the fake-relationship trope. With its mix of romantic drama, character growth, and lighthearted humor, the series highlights the blurry lines between obligation and true affection, slowly turning pretense into something more real.

I’m the Only One Who Knows That Jobless Is the Strongest

5.80

Action Adventure Drama Fantasy Seinen

Author: AOTSUKI Koji

Status: Ongoing

Dungeons have been appearing in the world for the past few years. Hunters, the cornerstone of clearing dungeons, each have a job with its own traits and abilities.The one said to be the weakest among all of them is “Jobless”. It has neither traits nor abilities. That’s why it’s not even thought of as a proper job.However, Meguru rises to an S-rank hunter with that very job and challenges the Sky Dungeon, which is known as the greatest obstacle.He worked with other S-rank hunters and, the moment he thought he’d defeated the final boss… He was stabbed from behind.The other S-ranks had betrayed him. As he took his final breaths, his sister Kanna was also killed.“I’ll never forgive you. I’ll kill each and every one of you…!”Meguru was reborn with that obsession.In his new life, he finds a girl who is the spitting image of Kanna.And like last time, his job was Jobless…With the knowledge of his past life and the future power of Jobless, Meguru will dominate everyone and everything.He starts conquering dungeons once again. This time with the ultimate goal of revenge.

The Manager and The Oblivious Waitress (매니저와 둔감한 웨이트리스, Maenijeowa Dungamhan Weiteuliseu) is a Korean manhwa that blends romance, comedy, and workplace dynamics into a charming story. The narrative follows a diligent yet often clueless waitress whose innocent mistakes and endearing personality catch the attention of the sharp and observant manager she works under. As they navigate daily challenges in the restaurant, their interactions evolve from humorous misunderstandings to heartfelt moments, highlighting the subtle development of their feelings. With witty dialogue, relatable scenarios, and a focus on character-driven humor, The Manager and The Oblivious Waitress captivates readers by offering a lighthearted yet emotionally engaging tale that combines workplace comedy with blossoming romance, making it a delightful read for fans of romantic manhwa.

E-Rank Healer

Author: Yukito Zakku

Status: Ongoing

E-Rank Healer (Eランクヒーラー, E-Rank Hīrā) is a fun and engaging fantasy manga that blends adventure, humor, and unexpected heroism. The story follows Lloyd, an underappreciated healer assigned the lowest rank in the adventurer guild, the E-Rank. Despite his seemingly weak abilities, Lloyd possesses a unique skill set that allows him to adapt creatively to dangerous situations, heal allies in unconventional ways, and survive where others fail. When he joins a party of higher-ranked adventurers, his hidden potential begins to shine as he overcomes monsters, navigates treacherous dungeons, and outsmarts powerful foes. With its lighthearted comedy, exciting battles, and heartwarming character development, E-Rank Healer turns the typical underdog story into an entertaining journey of growth and recognition. Perfect for fans of fantasy adventures and RPG-inspired narratives, this manga highlights that even the lowest-ranked healer can rise to prominence through cleverness, determination, and the courage to face overwhelming challenges.
